validation_control_decision.rule: Mean paired validation gain >=0.005; wins in >=2/3 seeds; nonzero selected circuit movement in every seed; prioritize largest mean gain

experiment_context.policy: Same rate grid, three seeds, fit cap, normalization, epochs and evaluation schedule; no test input to selection

plan.normalization_policy: All global fit images; validation excluded; optimization capped separately
plan.test_policy: No trained-model test evaluation until all validation tuning and replication fits finish
